title: Brains on their sleeve like the statue in Glasnevin.

anchor.text: Brains on their sleeve like the statue in Glasnevin.
anchor.prefix: dling. A mighthavebeen. Losing heart. Gambling. Debts of honour. Reaping the whirlwind. Used to get good retainers from D. and T. Fitzgerald. Their wigs to show their grey matter.
anchor.suffix: Believe he does some literary work for the Express with Gabriel Conroy. Wellread fellow. Myles Crawford began on the Independent. Funny the way those newspaper men veer about when
